headline: COP31 collapses without a deal; Democrats clinch a 258-seat House majority; Molly Meldrum dies at 83

austin.headline: AISD superintendent sees new options under Democratic state leaders
austin.summary: Matias Segura told KUT the election shift could change the state's takeover posture toward Austin ISD, which has earned a B rating for the first time in four years.

texas.headline: Democrats weigh new forms of property tax relief
texas.summary: Incoming Democratic leaders are considering longer homeowner breaks, payments to renters and more state school funding, after voters rejected most local tax-rate increases on Nov. 3.

us.headline: Democrats lock in at least 258 House seats
us.summary: The incoming Democratic House majority is the party's largest since 1992, the AP reports.

us.headline: Appeals court strikes down pregnant-worker accommodations law
us.summary: A federal appeals court ruled the law requiring employers to accommodate pregnant workers unconstitutional.

us.headline: Delta system glitch delays Thanksgiving travelers
us.summary: A problem with an automation system at Delta caused flight delays at the start of the holiday travel week.

us.headline: ICE detains father and daughter at Seattle airport
us.summary: Their lawyer says the pair, detained Saturday at Sea-Tac by officers in unmarked jackets, were travelling to a family baptism.

us.headline: Army to use emergency powers to destroy chemicals in Iowa
us.summary: The Army plans to invoke emergency provisions to detonate bomb-making chemicals in Iowa.

us.headline: Trump blames market slide on Democrats' midterm wins
us.summary: The president attributed the roughly $6 trillion stock market drop to the election results.

australia.headline: Molly Meldrum dies aged 83
australia.summary: The Countdown host and music industry figure has died, and his family has been offered a state funeral.

australia.headline: Taylor calls for Bowen to resign after COP31 failure
australia.summary: The Opposition Leader said the climate minister should go after the summit ended without a deal; Bowen defended Australia's efforts.

australia.headline: PBS medicine price freeze extended to 2030
australia.summary: Health Minister Mark Butler said the $25 cap will hold until 2030 at a cost of $242 million, as Albanese warned room for further cost-of-living relief is limited.

australia.headline: Small business sites exempted from digital duty of care
australia.summary: Low-risk business websites will be carved out of the online safety bill, which still needs Greens support to pass the Senate.

australia.headline: Chalmers warns of tougher times as ASX extends losing run
australia.summary: The treasurer flagged bigger deficits in the mid-year update as the ASX 200 fell for an eighth straight session and a flash PMI showed the sharpest activity drop in over five years.

australia.headline: Police presence boosted on Flinders Island after officer shot
australia.summary: Tasmania Police have increased their presence on the island after a local officer was shot.

ai.headline: Anthropic and Nvidia shares rebound in premarket trading
ai.summary: AI stocks rose before Monday's open after last week's steep tech sell-off.

ai.headline: Nasdaq 100 futures jump 3% to open holiday week
ai.summary: Futures rebounded sharply Sunday evening following the tech rout that erased the Nasdaq's 2026 gains.

ai.headline: No evidence ties recent outages to AI, review finds
ai.summary: A PolitiFact review found Microsoft and FAA disruptions stemmed from network and router upgrades, though AI tools are driving a surge in patched vulnerabilities.

ai.headline: Report proposes paid licensing for AI training on Australian content
ai.summary: A Minderoo Foundation report suggests a framework letting AI firms pay to train on Australian copyrighted material, ahead of a parliamentary AI inquiry report this week.

tech.headline: US probes Megaspeed in Nvidia chip smuggling case
tech.summary: Investigators are examining Megaspeed and a newly named figure, Alice Huang, in the Nvidia chip export case, CNBC reports.

tech.headline: Intelligence chief warns of more 'bumps' after tech outages
tech.summary: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton cautioned Americans to expect disruptions following recent FAA and Microsoft outages ahead of Thanksgiving.

world.headline: COP31 ends without a climate deal
world.summary: UN climate talks collapsed after the EU and others rejected the final deal proposal.

world.headline: Tanker incident reported near US blockade line off Iran
world.summary: UK maritime authorities reported a tanker incident involving military forces in the Gulf of Oman, while Iran said two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines.

world.headline: Ukraine says its drones hit Russian warship in Libya
world.summary: Zelenskyy said Ukrainian drones struck a Russian warship at a naval base in Libya.

world.headline: Fifteen missing after Russian drone strike near Kyiv
world.summary: A Russian drone attack on the Kyiv region left 15 people missing.

world.headline: Poland alleges Russian plots against Ukrainian American rapper
world.summary: Polish authorities say Russia twice tried to kill the musician.

world.headline: Deadly fire at Indonesian candy factory
world.summary: Twenty-four bodies have been recovered and about 30 people remain missing after a factory fire in Banten province.

aus-cricket.headline: Smith back for NSW as Shield round five begins
aus-cricket.summary: Steve Smith returns for NSW against Labuschagne's Queensland at the SCG, while WA hosts Tasmania in Perth from today.

warriors.headline: Warriors edge Celtics 88-87 to end losing streak
warriors.summary: Golden State snapped a five-game skid with a one-point home win over Boston on Sunday night.

warriors.headline: Kings visit Chase Center Wednesday
warriors.summary: Golden State hosts Sacramento on Nov. 25, with Brandon Williams (hamstring) eyeing a return; Curry, Moody, Butler and Porzingis remain out.
